name: Caravan
tagline: The long way is the good way.
description: A wandering identity for a road-trip outfitter. A rolling pennant, burnt sienna, and sturdy vintage lettering bring practical adventure back into focus.
heading: bebas
rules: The pennant always points right and uses the full-height mast.
Frame display headlines with badge-like rules and a small route label.
Use roadside teal sparingly against the warm main palette.

system.concept: Winding route illustrations, old road-sign geometry, stitched-looking badge frames, and sturdy condensed lettering. A practical travel world with a richly nostalgic landscape.
headline: Take the long way.
Bring good company.
system.eyebrow: GOODS FOR THE ROAD / NOTES FROM THE WAY
features: A focused set of things that make a journey feel easier.
Notes for taking a more curious road.
Practical design with the warmth of a familiar companion.
system.layoutNote: Desert hero with condensed road-sign headings and a layered landscape. Leather outlines, teal route accents, and badge-like equipment labels.
